descriptor.label: UN/EDIFACT message guide
descriptor.description: Export the types as a UN/EDIFACT message implementation guide (JSON, CSV and Markdown).

message_type.description: The message type: six letters (`ORDERS`, `INVOIC`, `DESADV` …). Default: an imported EDIFACT item's own, else `ORDERS`.
message_type.title: Message Type

release.description: The directory release (`96A`, `01B` …), written with version `D`. Default: an imported EDIFACT item's own, else `01B`.
release.title: Release

default_element_length.description: Maximum length of a text element with no maxLength (`an..35`).
default_element_length.title: Default Element Length

max_code_length.description: The longest code an enum value may be used as directly; a longer value (or one that is not upper-case letters and digits) gets a synthesized code.
max_code_length.title: Max Code Length

default_max_use.description: How many times a segment or segment group from a list with no maxItems may repeat.
default_max_use.title: Default Max Use
